official.deadline_note: Applications for the 2025/26 edition were accepted strictly through Studenti Online between 17 January 2025 at 12:00 CET and 30 May 2025 at 12:00 CEST, and the financial documentation window ran 22 January to 30 May 2025 at 12:00 CEST. No open International Talents @unibo call was listed on the University's bandi portal on 2026-10-10.
official.application_cycle: 2025/26 academic year edition; applications 17 January 2025 to 30 May 2025, ranking published on studenti.unibo.it, acceptance within 10 days of notification
official.status_note: The University publishes the 2025/26 call with 'scadenza: 30 maggio 2025, 12:00' and no replacement call was open on the bandi portal at the verification date.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The call states 'Successful applicants will also be offered a full tuition fee waiver. Successful applicants will be required to pay €157,04 (regional taxes, stamp duty and insurance premium. Amounts subject to change).'
benefits: 30 study grants worth €6.500 per academic year each
Each study grant is awarded for 2 academic years
Only €157.04 payable, covering regional taxes, stamp duty and insurance premium
eligibility: Holds a qualification valid for admission to the chosen Second cycle degree programme, awarded by an institution outside of the Italian education system; qualifications issued by institutions of the Republic of San Marino do not satisfy this condition and citizenship is irrelevant
Is not, and has never been, a student of a First, Single or Second cycle degree programme at the University of Bologna, including a student career ended after A.Y. 2023-24
Has an ISEE between €16.000 and €35.000, or an equivalent economic situation for those who cannot apply for an ISEE certificate
Has not applied for and received an Unibo Action 2 study grant in the past
Is less than 30 years old at the deadline for submitting applications
Matriculates for the first time in the first year of the degree programme; enrolling in later years, changing programme or transferring from another university is not matriculation
Is not enrolling in a multiple or joint degree programme for which tuition fees are payable to a partner university other than the University of Bologna
requirements: Submit the application strictly through Studenti Online between 17 January 2025 at 12:00 CET and 30 May 2025 at 12:00 CEST; applications on paper, by fax or by email will not be accepted
Register on studenti.unibo.it and replace the PUK code with a personal password; personal details must correspond exactly to those in the passport or identity card
Have the official GRE score report received by the University of Bologna through ETS no later than 30 May 2025, using recipient code 7850
Submit the ISEE 2025 certificate for higher education subsidies, or other financial requirements documents, through ER.GO
Send an email to internationaldesk@unibo.it within 10 days of the award notification to confirm unreserved acceptance
Upload all required documents in PDF format
documents: Copy of a valid passport; EU citizens may attach a copy of a valid identity document
Copy of the unofficial GRE score report
Official GRE score report sent through ETS with University of Bologna recipient code 7850
ISEE 2025 certificate for higher education subsidies, or the documents required for ISEE calculation where the family's income or assets are outside Italy
selection_criteria: Grants are awarded on the basis of the GRE (General Test); all sections are used and the test must have been taken after 30 May 2020
Minimum scores required: Verbal Reasoning + Quantitative Reasoning = 290 and Analytical Writing = 3.0; applicants scoring less will not be eligible
Each section is given equal weight and the final score is the sum of the three sections
Applicants are ranked in decreasing order of score; in case of a tie, preference is given to the younger applicant
The ranking list is approved by decree of the Head of Division and published on www.studenti.unibo.it
coverage: Study grant of €6,500 gross per academic year for 2 academic years, paid in 6 instalments
€157.04 payable by the holder for regional taxes, stamp duty and insurance premium
application_method: Register on studenti.unibo.it, using the 'International students registration' section if you do not have an Italian tax code
Go to 'Calls' and select the International Talents @Unibo call for the relevant academic year
Complete the online application and upload the passport and unofficial GRE score report as PDFs
Send the official GRE score report through ETS using recipient code 7850
Submit the ISEE or equivalent economic situation documentation through ER.GO
official.application_route: Apply online through Studenti Online (studenti.unibo.it) only; the official GRE score must also be dispatched through ETS to recipient code 7850.
official.citizenship_residency: Citizenship is irrelevant; the qualification must have been awarded by an institution outside the Italian education system, and qualifications issued by institutions of the Republic of San Marino do not satisfy this condition
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the study grants are intended for international students, defined as students whose admission qualification was obtained at an institution outside of the Italian education system, regardless of citizenship
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Second cycle (Laurea Magistrale) degree programmes at the University of Bologna; the grant may not be awarded to students enrolling in multiple or joint degree programmes for which tuition fees have to be paid to a partner university other than the University of Bologna
official.description: In order to encourage international students to enrol in its degree programmes, the University of Bologna has funded 30 study grants worth €6.500 per academic year each, awarded for 2 academic years to international students who matriculate in a Second cycle degree programme, together with a full tuition fee waiver.
official.program_type: University merit (GRE-based) and needs-linked study grant for international students matriculating in a Second Cycle degree programme

not_confirmed: english_requirement, which the call does not set for the scholarship itself; the degree programme governs language admission
the deadline for the next edition, since only the closed 2025/26 call is published on bandi.unibo.it
verification.notes: Grant value, number of grants, duration, tuition waiver, €157.04 residual charge, ISEE band, GRE thresholds, application window, instalment schedule and incompatibility list were all read from the English call for applications PDF published on bandi.unibo.it on 2026-10-10. Note the call states the English version is provided for information purposes only and that only the Italian version is legally valid.

applicant_utility.summary: €6,500 a year for two years plus a full tuition fee waiver for international students matriculating in the first year of a Bologna Laurea Magistrale, leaving only €157.04 of regional tax, stamp duty and insurance to pay. Ranking is decided by GRE General Test scores alone, so your GRE is effectively the entire competition: below 290 in Verbal plus Quantitative or 3.0 in Analytical Writing you are excluded no matter how strong your transcript is. Because the ISEE band is €16,000-€35,000 this is a needs-linked as well as a merit award, and the financial documentation runs through ER.GO rather than the scholarship portal.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Under-30 applicants holding a qualification from outside the Italian system, sitting in a middle-income band, who can score 290+ combined on GRE Verbal and Quantitative and 3.0 in Analytical Writing.
application_readiness_checklist: Book the GRE General Test early enough that the official score reaches ETS dispatch and the University by the closing date - later scores are not accepted
Verify your score against both minimums (290 combined Verbal and Quantitative; 3.0 Analytical Writing) before relying on this grant
Gather your family's income and asset position and confirm which ISEE route applies to you before the documentation window closes
Register on studenti.unibo.it, using the dedicated international students registration section if you have no Italian tax code
Match your registered personal details exactly to your passport before submitting, since mismatches are hard to correct
common_rejection_risks: Missing either GRE minimum, which is an absolute bar rather than a scoring penalty
The official GRE score arriving after 30 May - the call treats this as nullity
Being a current or former University of Bologna student, including a career that ended after A.Y. 2023-24
Holding or having held an Unibo Action 2 grant
Being 30 or over at the application deadline
Holding another incompatible grant, including ER.GO, MAECI, AICS, Collegio Superiore, CRUI, Erasmus Mundus and UNICORE study grants
Enrolling in a joint or multiple degree whose fees are paid to a partner university rather than Bologna
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: €157.04 for regional tax, stamp duty and insurance premium; living costs beyond the grant; flights to Bologna; and the cost of having GRE scores sent through ETS.
document_audit: The portal's status messages such as 'Application submitted' reflect only the technical step and do not mean your application is complete or eligible - verification happens after the deadline
Everything you upload must be in PDF format
Students from particularly poor or developing countries, or non-EU non-OECD countries, can opt for a reduced fixed fee in ER.GO but must still submit financial documents to enter this call
ER.GO checks all financial documents, and a negative outcome means losing the benefit
alerts: Acceptance is not automatic: you must email internationaldesk@unibo.it within 10 days of the award notification and confirm no incompatibility applies
Payment of the first scholarship instalment requires you to have completed matriculation and paid the first instalment of university fees
The grant is paid in six tranches tied to credit milestones (10 CFU by 15 February, 30 CFU by 15 July, and so on), not as a lump sum
Withdrawals received by 31 July allow the grant to move down the ranking; after that the award is not reallocated
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply through Studenti Online only, dispatch the official GRE score through ETS to code 7850, submit the ISEE or equivalent documents through ER.GO, then email unconditional acceptance to internationaldesk@unibo.it within 10 days of the ranking.

official.deadline_note: The application form must be submitted from 1 October 2026 until 12:00 noon (Italian time) on 15 December 2026. Only international students who paid the admission application fee between 1 October and 1 December 2026 are eligible. A valid certificate of English language proficiency must be submitted by 4 March 2027 to be considered for a scholarship.
official.application_cycle: Academic Year 2027/2028; call open 1 October 2026, scholarship form closing 15 December 2026, outcomes notified by email within three to four months of the application deadline
official.status_note: The Call for Applications for merit-based international scholarships for Academic Year 2027/2028 is published on the Politecnico di Milano website, with applications open from 1 October 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The call states 'All Merit Based International Scholarships include a tuition fee waiver for the academic year for which they are assigned' and that Silver Scholarships 'consist of a tuition fee waiver for the entire academic year which they are assigned for, with the exception of administrative fee and insurance'.
benefits: Full tuition fee waiver for the academic year the scholarship is assigned for
Gross cash allowance of €10,000 for Platinum, €8,000 for Gold, €5,000 for Gold Piacenza and €2,500 for Bronze Piacenza scholarships
Silver Scholarships: tuition fee waiver for the entire academic year, with the exception of administrative fee and insurance
eligibility: International students who apply to the first year of Master of Science programmes taught in English for academic year 2027-2028

Only international students who submitted their admission application to the first year of an English-taught Master of Science programme, paying the application fee between 1 October 2026 and 1 December 2026
Platinum and Gold: applicants to Master of Science programmes taught in English at the Milano Leonardo or Milano Bovisa Campuses

Gold Piacenza: applicants to Sustainable Architecture and Landscape Design (SAL), Landscape Architecture - Land Landscape Heritage (LLH) or Energy Engineering (Renewables and Environmental Sustainability, RES) at the Piacenza Campus
Bronze Piacenza: applicants to Mechanical Engineering (Mechatronics for Manufacturing) at the Piacenza Campus
Silver: applicants to Master of Science programmes taught in English on the Cremona, Lecco, Mantova or Piacenza Campuses
requirements: Application form submitted through Politecnico di Milano Online Services at Benefits and Agreements > Economic benefits > Scholarships for International Master of Science Students a.y. 2027-2028; no other method of application will be accepted under penalty of disqualification
Only candidates who have already applied for admission to the Master of Science programme may take part
The admission application fee must have been paid in the Early Bird window from 1 October to 1 December 2026
Recipients must accept the scholarship by paying the administrative fee of approximately €190.00 by the deadline in the award email, otherwise the scholarship is considered not accepted
Recipients must enrol in the academic year the scholarship is assigned for by the specified deadlines
Recipients must upload their IBAN code on Online Services under Data > Management of payment methods if not already on file
documents: IBAN code linked to an Italian bank account or a SEPA Area account, or a prepaid card linked to an Italian or SEPA account, uploaded on Online Services
Valid English language proficiency certificate uploaded on the platform used to submit the admission application and verified by the International Students Office
selection_criteria: Evaluation of previous education and its match with the requirements for the Master of Science programmes
The documents provided upon application and the scholarship application form
GPA and academic achievements, including the portfolio when requested, are of utmost importance

The Commission gives priority to candidates from countries that have been the victims of military aggression or are affected by civil wars, and takes into account merit-based criteria, geographic origin, gender balance and candidates' ages; in the event of a tie, priority is given to the younger candidate
The Commission considers only applicants who have been admitted to the degree programme and who accept the results of the evaluation
coverage: Tuition fee waiver for the academic year for which the scholarship is assigned
Gross allowance of €10,000 (Platinum), €8,000 (Gold), €5,000 (Gold Piacenza) or €2,500 (Bronze Piacenza), disbursed in two instalments
The scholarship amount does not cover the administrative fee and insurance, which remain payable
application_method: Apply for admission to an eligible English-taught Master of Science programme and pay the application fee between 1 October and 1 December 2026
Log in to Politecnico di Milano Online Services and open Benefits and Agreements > Economic benefits > Scholarships for International Master of Science Students a.y. 2027-2028
Complete and submit the scholarship application form by 12:00 noon Italian time on 15 December 2026
Watch for the outcome notification sent to the email address given at admission application, within three to four months of the deadline
Pay the administrative fee of approximately €190.00, upload the IBAN and enrol by the Student Affairs Office deadlines
Submit the valid English language proficiency certificate by 4 March 2027
official.application_route: Apply for admission and pay the fee in the Early Bird window, then submit the scholarship form through Politecnico di Milano Online Services by noon on 15 December 2026.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to international students; the call does not impose a residency condition beyond holding an admission application to an English-taught Master of Science programme
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the call is open to international students only
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: First year of a Master of Science programme taught in English, with the tier determined by programme and campus: Platinum and Gold (Milano Leonardo or Milano Bovisa), Gold Piacenza and Bronze Piacenza (Piacenza Campus, named programmes), Silver (Cremona, Lecco, Mantova or Piacenza)
official.duration: One academic year; renewable for 2028-2029 on academic points (1,000 points for Platinum and 700 points for Gold, Bronze and Silver, calculated as the sum of exam grades weighted by their ECTS, by 10 August 2028)
official.description: Thanks to the cooperation with public and private partners, every year Politecnico di Milano offers a number of merit-based scholarships to the most talented international candidates admitted to a Master of Science programme starting from the first semester. All scholarships include a full tuition-fee waiver, and some also provide an additional gross allowance up to €10,000 per year.
official.program_type: University merit-based scholarship scheme for international Master of Science applicants (Platinum, Gold, Bronze and Silver tiers)
official.english_requirement: A valid certificate of English language proficiency must be submitted by 4 March 2027 to be considered for a scholarship; candidates must have accepted the admission outcome and uploaded a valid language certificate on the admission application platform, verified by the International Students Office.

not_confirmed: living_cost_coverage is inferred from the gross cash allowance, since the call does not label the allowance as living-cost support
the exact administrative fee, published as approximately €190.00 on the call and 'about €170' on the scholarships page
verification.notes: Tier counts and amounts, the €190 administrative fee, the application window and noon deadline, the Early Bird eligibility condition, the priority given to candidates from countries affected by military aggression or civil war, the IBAN payment rules and the renewal point thresholds were all read from the official Merit Based Call for Applications a.y. 2027-2028 PDF on 2026-10-10.

applicant_utility.summary: 64 international scholarships across five tiers for the first year of an English-taught MSc at Politecnico di Milano: every tier carries a tuition-fee waiver, and the cash tiers add €10,000 (Platinum), €8,000 (Gold), €5,000 (Gold Piacenza) or €2,500 (Bronze Piacenza) gross, while Silver is a waiver only. The critical sequencing trap is that you must have applied for admission and paid the application fee inside the Early Bird window of 1 October to 1 December 2026 before the scholarship form will even accept you, and that form closes at noon Italian time on 15 December 2026. The Commission also gives explicit priority to candidates from countries that have been victims of military aggression or are affected by civil wars, which matters if that applies to you.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Strong-GPA applicants to an English-taught Milan or Piacenza-campus MSc who can pay the admission fee in Early Bird and produce an accepted English certificate on time.
application_readiness_checklist: Submit the admission application and pay the €170-190 application fee between 1 October and 1 December 2026 - missing Early Bird ends your scholarship chances
Confirm which tier your programme and campus actually fall under before you budget, since Silver carries no cash
Upload an accepted English certificate well before 4 March 2027 and confirm the International Students Office has verified it
Open or arrange an Italian or SEPA bank account, or a prepaid card in your own name with a credit limit at least equal to the award, before payment
Diary the acceptance deadline in the award email and pay the administrative fee immediately, since an unpaid fee is treated as a refusal
common_rejection_risks: Paying the admission application fee after 1 December 2026, which makes you ineligible for the whole call
Not being admitted, or not accepting the admission outcome, since the Commission only considers admitted candidates who accept
Failing to upload the English certificate by 4 March 2027
Missing the administrative fee deadline in the award email, which the call treats as non-acceptance
Not enrolling in the academic year the scholarship was assigned for, which forfeits the award even after acceptance
Applying for a campus that does not offer the tier you assumed, for example expecting cash at Cremona, Lecco or Mantova where only the Silver waiver exists
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The administrative fee and insurance (expressly excluded from the Silver waiver), plus the €170-190 application and administrative fees, accommodation in Milan or the provinces, and flights.
document_audit: The IBAN must be linked to an Italian or SEPA account held in your name, jointly held with a family member, or a prepaid card in your name only whose credit limit is at least the scholarship amount
Only the Online Services route is accepted; any other submission method is disqualifying
The language certificate must be uploaded on the admission application platform, not sent separately
Gold Piacenza and Bronze Piacenza are campus-funded, so check the named programme list before applying
alerts: Outcomes arrive by email within three to four months of the 15 December deadline, so expect news around March or April 2027 rather than sooner
Renewal for year two is points-based (1,000 for Platinum, 700 for Gold, Bronze and Silver) and credits from extra ECTS, internships or a separate academic career are excluded
You must continue in the same Master of Science programme to keep a renewed award, so a programme switch resets the benefit
The tier you win depends on the campus and programme, so an attractive cash figure is not available everywhere
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Admission application and Early Bird fee payment first, then the scholarship form in Online Services by noon on 15 December 2026, then email notification, administrative fee payment, enrolment, IBAN upload and the English certificate by 4 March 2027.
